<thought>Using the retrieved DBE formula DBE = (2C + 2 + N - H - X)/2 and the given molecular formula C6H9O2 (C=6, H=9, N=0, X=0), DBE = (2*6 + 2 - 9)/2 = 5/2 = 2.5. Since DBE must be reported as an integer, we round to the nearest whole number, yielding 2.</thought>
<final_answer>2</final_answer>
